comparison.objective: Configure case standoffs to match four mini-ITX holes, then mount the board versus tune a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Threaded fastener placement, pattern matching, board alignment, and mounting versus adjuster unlocking, fine rotation, relocking, and iterative dynamics assessment.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly four matching standoffs and no extras must support the mounted board; candidate needs two compliant stopping cycles and no drift.
comparison.reason: Threaded manipulation is generic overlap only; board mounting tests pattern correspondence and assembly, not calibration. Torque and seating tolerances are absent.
